assertions.assertion: States that events are NOT enabled by default and enables RaiseSuccessEvents, RaiseFailureEvents, RaiseErrorEvents, and RaiseInformationEvents in AddIdentityServer
assertions.rationale: Enables all four Raise* flags; notes flags must be enabled or events are swallowed.

assertions.assertion: Implements and registers a custom IEventSink (e.g. AddTransient<IEventSink, ...>) for Seq
Warns that a custom IEventSink replaces the default ASP.NET Core logger sink (each event goes to exactly one sink), so the custom sink must forward to logging to keep log output
assertions.rationale: Only says register after AddIdentityServer 'so it replaces the default sink'; no warning that logging output is lost and sink must forward (though its code happens to log).

assertions.assertion: Explains that UI login success/failure events must be raised by your own UI code via IEventService.RaiseAsync, since IdentityServer only raises protocol events itself
assertions.rationale: Says UI login events are not raised automatically and shows IEventService.RaiseAsync.
